boot.slow: The server is taking a while. Just a moment...

home.tagline: Tap to flap your wings. Let go and gravity takes its toll.
home.offlineNotice: Can't reach the server. You can practice in the meantime.

game.chanceVideoOnly: Your bird still has an extra chance: watch a video and pick up from here.
game.chanceMany: The extra chance picks up from here — {count} per run with this bird.
game.chanceOne: The extra chance picks up from here — one per run.
game.resumedText: Your run picks up where it left off, with {points}. Tap to keep going.
game.chanceText: You're back with {points}. Tap to fly.
game.chanceTextCoins: You're back with {points} and {coins}. Tap to fly.
game.trainingText: No internet: you can fly, but without coins, lives or leaderboard.
game.tapText: Each tap gives you a boost. Fly through the coins in the gaps.
game.winText: {stages} stages, {obstacles} obstacles, ice, double gravity and gaps on the move. None of it brought you down. Congratulations.
game.afterWin: From here on the game keeps the pace of stage {n}. Your score keeps counting.
game.shieldHint: The shield forgives hits while it fades.
game.trainingNoRewards: No coins, lives or leaderboard in practice.
game.someRejected: Some coins weren't accepted by the server.
game.offlineFinish: No connection right now. This run's coins will be added when you're back online, with the app open.
game.offlineRestart: Can't reach the server. Go back to the menu to practice.

shop.title: Shop
shop.offlineBody: Your coins, birds and items are stored on the server — without a connection you can't see or buy anything. Practice mode still works.
shop.skinBought: Added to your collection: {name}. Tap Use to wear it.
shop.birdBought: {name} is yours! Tap Use to fly with it.
shop.shieldDesc: Forgives hits while it fades. Use it at the start of a stage.
shop.continueDesc: When you fall, carry on from the same spot — once per run.
shop.noSkins: No skins in the shop right now. Check back soon.
shop.noSkinInUse: No skins in use. They work on any bird and show up for others on the leaderboard.

comet.name: Comet
comet.tagline: Leaves a trail wherever it goes.

cap_red.name: Red Cap
cap_red.tagline: The classic, with a white button.

cap_propeller.name: Propeller Cap
cap_propeller.tagline: Four colors and a propeller on top.

necklace_medal.name: Gold Medallion
necklace_medal.tagline: A champion's medal on your chest.

necklace_diamond.name: Diamond Necklace
necklace_diamond.tagline: A gold chain and a blue stone.

magnet.name: Magnet
magnet.desc: Pulls in nearby coins: {on} on{stars}, {cooldown} to recharge.

ghost.name: Invisible
ghost.desc: Passes through obstacles without falling: {on} invisible{stars}, {cooldown} to recharge.

slow.name: Slow motion
slow.desc: The stage moves {percent}% slower for {on}{stars}; then recharges for {cooldown}.

extraChance.name: Second chance
extraChance.descVideo: One extra chance per run, by watching a video.
extraChance.descManyVideo: {count} extra chances per run, by watching a video.

coinMultiplier.name: Double coins
coinMultiplier.desc: Coins collected in flight are worth double at the end of the run.
coinMultiplier.descMany: Coins collected in flight are worth {count} times as much at the end of the run.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.seasonCounting: Round closed for tallying. The next one opens in {time}.
leaderboard.offlineBody: This app isn't connected to a server yet, so groups and the player leaderboard don't work. Your best score and history are still saved on this device, in the “Your flights” tab.
leaderboard.offlineSetup: To turn it on: start the server in the {folder} folder (it's a {command}) and put its address in {file}.
leaderboard.empty: No one has scored this round yet. Be the first.
leaderboard.footnote: Your round score is the sum of all your runs in it.
leaderboard.nameTooShort: Use a name with at least 2 letters.
leaderboard.noGroupTitle: You don't have a group yet
leaderboard.noGroupBody: Create one and invite up to {max} players. The group score is the sum of what everyone does in the round — and you stay on the individual leaderboard just the same.
leaderboard.leaderNote: Whoever creates it becomes the leader — only they can invite people, and only they wear the crown.
leaderboard.groupFull: The group is full. To invite someone else, someone has to leave.
leaderboard.inviteHint: Ask for the player's code (they'll find it in Settings) and paste it here.
leaderboard.noRuns: No flights recorded yet. Play a run and it shows up here.
leaderboard.prizes: Round prizes: 1st {first} · 2nd {second} · 3rd {third} coins, paid when it closes.
leaderboard.allTimeNote: The sum of every round — it never resets.

settings.title: Settings
settings.flapDesc: The flap of wings on every tap
settings.yourNameDesc: This is how you appear on the leaderboard and in your group.
settings.codeHint: Send it to whoever is inviting you to a group. Only the leader can add someone, and they need this code.
settings.shareMessage:
Invite me to your group in Major Flyer! My player code is:

{code}
